name: Drupitor Client
description: Safely collect and expose available Composer updates for Drupal projects via Drupitor integration.
project_description: The Drupitor Client module provides a token-authenticated JSON API endpoint that reports which Composer package updates are available for a Drupal installation, for consumption by the external Drupitor monitoring service. The endpoint runs Composer on the server (via proc_open) to determine current and latest versions of every installed package, encrypts the resulting inventory with an AES key shared with the Drupitor host, and returns it at /drupitor/api/v1/updates. The module is disabled by default and requires an admin to enable it, set the Drupitor-provided API token, and set the encryption key before the endpoint responds. It depends only on core System and User and supports Drupal 10 and 11.
